title: osu! folder
description: Absolute stable installation folder for offline rendering. Leave empty to follow the active osu! client. Songs, Skins and Replays are read only.

title: Songs folder override
description: Optional absolute Songs folder, including installations with a custom BeatmapDirectory.

title: Offline skin
description: Skin folder name under Skins, used when the active client has no current skin.

title: Default mania scroll speed
description: Default for replay tracks without a player preset. Per-replay overrides never modify osu! settings.
